slides.title: Hero [[Query]]
slides.code:
SELECT email
FROM users
GROUP BY email
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
slides.note: Bina **GROUP BY** ke query nahi chalegi!

slides.title: Query [[Breakdown]]
slides.note: Filter ke liye **HAVING** use hota hai 💡

slides.title: Final [[Result]]
slides.note: Sirf wahi email aaya jo **repeat** hua ✌️

slides.title: Where vs [[Having]]
slides.note: Interview mein ye diff **zaroor** puchte hain!

slides.wrong: SELECT email FROM users WHERE COUNT(*) > 1;
slides.right: SELECT email FROM users GROUP BY email HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
slides.why: WHERE mein **aggregate** (COUNT) nahi chalta! Pehle group karo phir filter 🚫
